name: Chinese Money Plant
hook: Pilea getting leggy? It's asking for more light.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: Set it back from a bright window or behind a sheer curtain; direct summer sun scorches the coin leaves.

steps.title: Water when top 2 cm is dry
steps.tip: Water through, then never leave it standing in water. Pilea is prone to root rot.

steps.title: Comfortable room temps
steps.tip: 18–24°C by day and above 13°C at night, away from drafts, vents and heaters.

steps.title: Pot up the pups
steps.tip: Separate the offsets that pop up around the base and pot them on their own: free plants for friends.

steps.title: Go up 5 cm at a time
steps.tip: Repot into free-draining, peat-free houseplant mix, in a pot about 5 cm wider than the root ball.

steps.title: Keep the leaves dry
steps.tip: Water the soil, not the leaves, to avoid leaf spot, and check for mites, mealybugs and fungus gnats.

outro: Bright, indirect light and careful watering: then share the pups.
